assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original background painting for a dark fantasy deckbuilding game's main menu, landscape 16:9, high quality. Hand-painted gouache and ink art with strong angular shapes, restrained textured brushwork, dramatic but readable silhouette. A colossal crooked black stone spire with impossible stacked buttresses rises from a windswept jagged gorge on the RIGHT HALF, a narrow winding stair leading toward its amber-lit doorway. Desaturated charcoal, dusty olive, warm stone, muted burnt sienna, pale ochre cloudy sky. A few tiny ember sparks, ancient ruined pillars in foreground. LEFT 48 PERCENT is mostly quiet near-black rock and shadow, low detail negative space reserved for UI text; right side atmospheric and richly illustrated. Bottom strip dark shadow. Strong theatrical composition that feels like a beautiful painted fantasy boardgame, not realistic 3D or glossy concept art. No characters, no lettering, no UI, no logos, no watermark. This will sit behind crisp real UI and must be an actual artwork, not a screenshot or mockup.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE production sprite atlas of 32 original fantasy card illustrations, not a UI mockup. EXACTLY 8 equal columns and 4 equal rows, 32 square cells in a landscape 2:1 sheet, ideally 2048x1024. No gaps, no margins, no borders, no text, letters, numbers, frames or watermarks anywhere. Each cell is a different separate full-bleed illustration with straight boundaries. Each main subject is centered, bold and recognizable at 120 pixels; keep critical content within central 75 percent of each square. Consistent hand-painted gouache and black ink, angular graphic shapes, rough paper texture, dark charcoal backgrounds, warm ivory rim light, restrained copper, bone, moss green, teal and plum. Sophisticated fantasy boardgame art matching a ruined stone tower game, not photoreal or glossy 3D. Draw these cells in exact left-to-right order: ROW 1 Ironclad, muted red copper accents: (1) a single broadsword slashing diagonally; (2) battered iron kite shield stopping sparks; (3) massive iron mace smashing a stone slab; (4) warrior spinning sword inside circular storm of red slashes; (5) armored fist holding demonic fire, horned shadow behind it; (6) hand throwing a fan of burning cards into roaring fire; (7) scarred red-cloaked warrior bracing crossed forearms against arrows; (8) giant executioner's hammer crashing into cracked armor. ROW 2 Silent, moss green accents: (1) a lone curved dagger cutting through leaves; (2) forest-green cloak wrapped around a defensive forearm; (3) tiny silver throwing blade striking a suspended vial; (4) hooded masked rogue crouching behind a broken pillar; (5) glass flask dripping green poison onto a leaf; (6) a crude narrow Shiv gleaming on dark cloth; (7) ghostly hooded rogue dissolving into pale green smoke; (8) cracked venom-filled skull emitting a poisonous cloud. ROW 3 Defect, tarnished bronze and teal accents: (1) bronze robot fist striking with sparks; (2) curved brass plating surrounding a small blue core; (3) a lightning orb with a single branching bolt; (4) two luminous lightning orbs colliding in a bright pulse; (5) robot hands holding a blue icy glacier crystal; (6) many turquoise electrical arcs joining three metal rods; (7) a bronze automaton core casting a second spectral copy; (8) a dark violet orb with a small hot light at its center. ROW 4 Watcher, dusty plum and gold accents: (1) golden staff striking diagonally; (2) folded violet sleeves held in a guarding pose; (3) staff planted in ground with a burst of red-orange wrath; (4) seated blindfolded monk inside a quiet gold circle; (5) small radiant golden crystal cupped in a hand; (6) outstretched palm with a gold sigil on it; (7) violet paper talisman floating in a ring of sacred flame; (8) closed eye reflected in three hovering fragments of a mirror. Preserve all 32 distinct subjects and exact 8 by 4 grid. One coherent painted atlas.
assets.processing: Downscaled the original 1774×887 RGB PNG to 1536×768 and encoded as WebP (quality 84, method 6). Runtime frames use measured row boundaries [0, 192, 384, 560, 768] and a four-pixel inset. 32 illustrations, with class/type fallbacks for the remaining catalog.

Isolated characters ONLY, no scenery, no tile backgrounds, no frames, no text, no labels, no letters, no logo, no ground shadows. All four face slightly toward the right.
